decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a low-cost variant of the established offer and gained visibility in 2024 with a page of its own, so keeping this option open costs little while demand for black bathroom design is still unfolding.

The shower channel for seamless coverings has had a dedicated page for two years running, which signals a positive commitment that fits the firm's barrier-free, design-led strategy, so there is no reason to abandon it.
The pump-drain shower channel launched only in 2024, so its value is still highly uncertain and worth waiting on, even though the earlier pump-assisted solution was withdrawn and adds some risk.
